description: Search the moments Real Alpha cut from long interviews with the people building AI. Matches the words of `query` against what each moment is about, the speaker's quote and its takeaways, best match first. Filter by who is talking (`person`), a company (someone from it talking, or it being discussed), a show, or how recent. Each result has the speaker, what they do, the show, the date, their quote, and the moment's page to cite.

company.description: Only moments from someone at this company, or about it: "Anthropic", "Nvidia"

limit.description: How many moments to return, 8 if not given, 20 at most

person.description: Only moments where this person is talking, by name: "Sam Altman", "Dario Amodei"

query.description: What to look for, in a few words: "AI bubble", "coding agents replacing engineers", "scaling laws"

show.description: Only moments from this show: "Lenny's Podcast", "Dwarkesh Podcast", "No Priors"

since.description: Only episodes out on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

name: search_moments
title: Search what AI leaders said
